subject: Close a shiny app from the interface

messages.author: 6fc1ee4c13e90f45
messages.subject: Close a shiny app from the interface
parts:
Hi,

When I run a shiny app locally with runApp() from an R console, I must use Control-C or Esc to kill the App and get the R prompt back.
I wondered if there is a way to do this from within the shiny App itself. For example, a "Close" button in the shiny UI that would stop the app.

Sorry, maybe what I ask is not compatible with the way the framework is working...

Thanks !

Julien

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Close a shiny app from the interface

messages.author: 6fc1ee4c13e90f45
messages.subject: Re: Close a shiny app from the interface
parts:
?shiny::stopApp

Ah great, Thanks !  Didn't see this one because the package version on rdocumentation.org is a bit outdated.
